name: worldmonitor
description: World Monitor agent plugin: live global-intelligence MCP servers plus task-focused agent skills for country risk, conflict, markets, chokepoints, energy, climate, and related situational awareness.

interface.longDescription: Explore source-attributed news, country risk, conflicts, markets, energy and maritime chokepoints with WorldMonitor tools and task-focused skills. Inspect gold positioning and holdings, traffic anomalies and global DDoS observations. Compare dated CPI and rate histories, research stocks and technical backtests, and model energy or import-cost exposure to chokepoint closures. Research and scenario results retain model limitations and do not establish future performance. Browse curated news panels and a 2D map or 3D globe, search headlines, and summarize or translate selected headlines. Data can be partial, stale or unavailable; answers retain coverage and attribution. Connect your WorldMonitor account through OAuth; some workflows require a subscription. Research generation may save shared snapshots. The plugin does not trade, publish articles or change account settings. Map controls work in the UI; model control of an already-open map depends on host support.
capabilities: Model chokepoint supply and cost exposure
defaultPrompt: Show today’s world headlines with sources and coverage.
Translate one current headline into Arabic.
